query: I have a 57-year-old female post–cardiac arrest inpatient. Among females 52–62 with post–cardiac arrest, in the first 48 h what is the instability score IQR (Q1, median)? Compare critical lab events/admission to general inpatients and report cohort LOS and mortality.
final_sql: SELECT (q3.q3 - q1.q1) AS interquartile_range, median.median AS median_value, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admissions WHERE gender = 'F' AND age BETWEEN 52 AND 62 AND hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM labevents WHERE itemid = 227989 AND charttime BETWEEN 0 AND 48)) AS subpopulation_size, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admissions WHERE gender = 'F' AND age BETWEEN 57 AND 57 AND hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM labevents WHERE itemid = 227989 AND charttime BETWEEN 0 AND 48)) AS case_size, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admissions WHERE gender = 'F' AND age BETWEEN 52 AND 62 AND hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM labevents WHERE itemid = 227989 AND charttime BETWEEN 0 AND 48)) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admissions WHERE gender = 'F' AND age BETWEEN 57 AND 57), 0) AS proportion FROM q1, median, q3;
